| [Barrier triage](SKILL.md) | Agent Skill | Classify why a machine will not connect (legacy hardware, protocol with no route, missing PLC program, platform not installed, Cyber Security wait, data model) and route it to one of three exits - the integration roadmap, strategy, or a substitution path - with an owner and a logged barrier, instead of leaving the machine silently out of the wave. Builds on the fallback ladder and barrier classes of od-equipment-integration. Use when a machine cannot be connected or an assessment finds no route, when a blocker text such as "firmware patching required" or "PLC program missing" is recorded, or when someone asks whether a stuck machine is a roadmap, strategy or substitution matter. |
